title: unix-socket-options
description: Optional attributes for a filesystem UNIX socket. TCP, abstract sockets, and Windows do not support these options.

mode.description: An octal permission string from 0000 through 0777. Omitted or empty values keep the operating system default.

uid.description: The numeric socket owner ID. Omit this value to keep the operating system default.

gid.description: The numeric socket group ID. Omit this value to keep the operating system default.
